Lord '''Rommath''' is the Grand Magister of the [[Silvermoon Remnant]], one of the members of the [[Regency Council]] of [[Alah'Thalas]], as well as the most powerful Magister after the fall on Quel'Thalas at the hands of the undead Scourge.

== Biography ==
Rommath was a member of the Magisterium, the Quel'dorei's traditional order of magi.

After the fall of Quel'Thalas, he eventually joined the Silvermoon Remnant. When Alah'Thalas was expanded beyond an outpost into a city, and the Thalassian Highlands resettled by high elf refugees, the surviving nobles pushed to remove Vereesa Windrunner from her position as Speaker of the Silvermoon Remnant, establishing the [[Regency Council]] in which Rommath would take part in along with Vereesa, Lor'themar Theron and other nobles.

Although Prince [[Kael'thas Sunstrider]] is considered to be a traitor by the Remnant, Rommath remains secretly loyal to the Prince and keeps in contact with him, maintaining a line of communication between the Prince in Outland and the remaining blood elves in [[Felstrider Retreat]]<ref>[[Rommath's Orders]]</ref><ref>{{questlong|Alliance|9|An Audience With the Prince}}</ref> as Kael'thas continues to seek the path to salvation for his people.

When Lord [[Astalor Sunsworn]] made a motion before the Council to be named Lord-Regent of Quel'Thalas following the retaking of [[Shalandis Isle]] by the [[Silver Covenant]], Rommath voted in his favor.<ref name="A Good Day"/>
